data.name: Buzzoria
data.detailed_description:
Bees are now the dominant inhabitants of Earth, and you lead one of their colonies.

The previous inhabitants are gone. Nobody knows what happened to them, but their everyday objects, damaged remains, and unfinished history are still buried beneath the soil.

Build your colony above the ruins, recover forgotten objects, and uncover the truth one discovery at a time.

Excavate layer by layer

Scan the ground, adjust your tool radius, and choose the right approach for every site. Dig carefully, clear broad areas, blast deep craters with dynamite, or restore the terrain using earth you have recovered.

Soil depth and material resistance shape every excavation. A small object may be resting just beneath the grass—or hidden far below the surface.

Every discovery becomes part of the story

Every extracted find is recorded in your Finds archive. Its condition determines how much honey it produces when recovered, so careful excavation is always worthwhile.

Common objects reveal how the old world once lived. Story relics remain in your archive as clues and objectives in the campaign.

Build a living colony

Honey is the heart of your economy. Spend it on actions, tools, skills, hive upgrades, and the creatures that keep your settlement growing.

Expand your hives, plant flowers, establish anthills, and attract ladybugs and butterflies. Your colony is not just a backdrop: its workers, resources, and dangers shape every decision.

Protect what you build

Contamination spreads across the surface and hostile bees threaten living targets inside its danger zone. Flowers, lakes, guards, anthills, and hives can all be damaged over time.

Command your guards from the hive, defend the colony, and strike enemy hives when you are ready. Even a fallen hive can be restored—your story does not end with a single defeat.

A cozy game for your desktop

Buzzoria is designed for short, relaxing sessions. Scan, dig, discover, and check on your colony whenever you have a few quiet minutes.

When you need to focus, collapse your chosen companion into a tiny always-on-top portrait. One click brings the full world of Buzzoria back.

Someone is watching

The colony calls him the Watcher. He appeared without explanation, observes your discoveries, and knows more than he says.

Who is he? Where did he come from? And what does he know about the world before the bees?

data.short_description: A cozy excavation and colony-building game about bees, buried relics, and the mysterious Watcher. Dig through the remains of a vanished civilization, recover valuable finds, grow your colony, and uncover the truth one discovery at a time.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4400 or better (WebGL support)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 (2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with WebGL support (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 900 series / AMD Radeon RX 400)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or later) or Intel Core M / i5
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Apple GPU / Intel HD Graphics) — WebGL required
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey)+
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5+
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M-series GPU or Intel Iris / AMD Radeon Pro
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
